Game Overview

In Assault, the core idea is straightforward: prepare for an intense defense as you strategically place specialized turrets to fend off relentless waves of enemies in Assault. Balance resource management and tactical planning to protect your command center. Adapt to escalating challenges with each wave, ensuring no foe breaches your carefully crafted defenses.
